name: incident-triage
description: Triage a concrete technical failure (stack trace, failing test, runtime symptom, production alert), classify it and pick a fix size (HOTFIX/SLICE/INVESTIGATION/ESCALATE). Use when there is concrete failure evidence, an active task folder exists, and urgency is real or unclear, or hotfix versus full flow is unclear. Do not use when it is not concrete (use im-stuck or what-next), feature-shaped (use task-init), already fixed (use pr-package), from PR feedback (use pr-feedback-ingest or post-review-pivot), or no task folder exists.
